messages.subject: Adjacency Graph Error
parts:
Hi all,

I have run CAR model (bym) using a graph defined uisng 3700 polygons, its returns the folloiwng error, what could be the problem 

ormulab<-K ~ 1 + A+ f(reg0,model="bym",graph="KEN.adj",  scale.model = TRUE, 
                          hyper = list(prec.unstruct=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(0.5,0.0005)), 
                          prec.spatial=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(0.5,0.0005))))+
                          f(time0,model="rw1", constr = TRUE, scale.model = TRUE) +
                          f(time1, model = "iid", constr = TRUE)+
                          f(time2,model="iid", group=reg1,control.group=list(model="iid"),constr=TRUE)



Error in if (n.from.graph <= 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning message:
In inla.read.graph.ascii.internal(..., size.only = size.only) :

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Adjacency Graph Error
parts:
Hi,

in this case it assumes that 'Ken.adj' is the filename where the graph
is stored, and there are some errors there.

you may do

g = inla.debug.graph('Ken.adj')

to see what happens. otherwise, send the file to me and I'll check.

H
